policy: Every https://doi.org citation in the listed research-bearing files is discovered automatically. Release QA validates DOI syntax, coverage and review dates without network access. The scheduled freshness workflow asks the DOI resolver for citation metadata. A DOI resolver 404/410 is a hard review trigger; temporary access, publisher, rate-limit or network failures are warnings rather than evidence that a study disappeared. Evidence-maturity datasets, material practice and psychometric methods are included in the same DOI discovery gate.
